title: Bifunctional photoactive nanomaterials for sustainable paper-based photobatteries: powering point-of-care medical biosensors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5490-5533
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00945F, Review Article
Natasha Ross, Kayode Adesina Adegoke, Mieke Adriaens
Bifunctional materials serve as photoactive electrodes for light harvesting, providing the power supply for POC microfluidic devices used in wireless biosensor monitoring.
